decisions.statement: The ring drawn is the one Alan's upkeep tile draws rather than one of its own.
The stoplight a ring is handed is decoded as the shape every ring is handed.
The color of a reading that is not falling is read off the feed.
The color of a falling reading is read off the figure this tile draws.
However many stoplights the feed sends is however many rings are drawn.
A refused fetch tells Jenny to update the app rather than showing no signal.
A tap on this tile opens nothing.
Jenny's app holds no page for the upkeep.

definition: Jenny's tile for the stoplight on each of Alan's upkeep readings
